title: Placement and choice
slide_intent: Relate the choice of lockup to the shape of the available space so a long name can remain prominent on a narrow sign.
strategic_value: A single venue identity can fit horizontal or vertical signage without losing the lettering and line device that identify the site.
demonstration: Weston Park Museum appears stacked in a centered field, horizontal in a strip, rotated along a narrow vertical panel and stacked at the foot of another tall panel.
practical_value: Compare the rotated horizontal master with the bottom-centered stacked master for a narrow upright format.

content_islands.name: Choice guidance
content_islands.spec: Explain stacked and horizontal options in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Broad formats
content_islands.spec: Group the centered stacked specimen and the centered long specimen. Mark their primary and secondary choices.

content_islands.name: Tall formats
content_islands.spec: Set two equal vertical panels side by side. Compare the long rotated mark with the small stacked mark at the bottom and label each option.
